## The first few spherical harmonics

![The first few spherical harmonics.](images/ch57/the-first-few-spherical-harmonics.png){#fig-ch57-the-first-few-spherical-harmonics}

Visual representations of the first few real spherical harmonics. Blue portions represent regions where the function is positive, and yellow portions represent where it is negative. The distance of the surface from the origin indicates the value of {\displaystyle Y_{\ell }^{m}(\theta ,\phi )} in angular direction {\displaystyle (\theta ,\phi )}.
